top_offers.title: Staff AI Engineer, AI Transformation
top_offers.why: Staff role owning the technical architecture of Multiverse's agentic operating system, a close match for someone already running AI-augmented engineering practices at Benevity and building a platform from scratch at Alaya. The company just raised $70M at a $2.1bn valuation as Europe's first EdTech double unicorn, and the role is remote-friendly out of London.

top_offers.title: Head of Engineering
top_offers.why: Hands-on Head of Engineering at a profitable Geneva SaaS company (Sign.Plus, Fax.Plus, plus two AI products: Dial.Plus voice agent and Scan.Plus scanner) serving 4M+ customers, posted only two days ago. The own-delivery-across-products scope echoes the founding/platform-owner pattern from Alaya, and it's one of the very few genuine Geneva openings this run turned up.

top_offers.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform
top_offers.why: Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team at Sean Parker's well-funded social-AI startup, building reusable infrastructure for a fast-moving product. Reasonable tech and role-impact fit, but the listing reads as SF/LA onsite with no remote option surfaced, which is the main drag against a Geneva-based candidate.
